title: ownermapping
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, importmapid, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, targetsystemuserid.

createdon.description: Date and time when the owner mapping was created.

introducedversion.description: Version in which the component is introduced.

ismanaged.description: Information that specifies whether this component is managed.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the owner mapping was last modified.

ownermappingid.description: Unique identifier of the owner mapping.

processcode.description: Code that indicates whether the owner mapping has to be processed

solutionid.description: Unique identifier of the associated solution.

sourcesystemusername.description: Source user name that has to be replaced

sourceuservalueforsourcecrmuserlink.description: Source user value for source Microsoft Dynamics 365 user link.

statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the owner mapping.

targetsystemuserdomainname.description: Microsoft Dynamics 365 logon name with which the source user name should be replaced.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the owner mapping.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the ownermapping.

_importmapid_value.description: Unique identifier of the data map with which the owner mapping is associated.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who last modified the lookup mapping.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who last modified the ownermapping.

_targetsystemuserid_value.description: Unique identifier of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 user.
